test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

The children were __merry __than usual on Sunday.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the comparative form of the adjective "**merry**."
 
• When comparing two things, the correct comparative form of "merry" is "**merrier**."
 
• Thus, the sentence should use "merrier" instead of "merry than usual."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The children were **merrier** than usual on Sunday."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "more merrier"** – This is grammatically incorrect as "merrier" is already a comparative form and does not need "more".
 
• **Option 2: "the merriest"** – This is the superlative form and not suitable for comparing two things.
 
• **Option 3: "merriest"** – This is also a superlative form and not suitable for comparing two things.
